reasoning: Subtract the required concentration from each type. A positive-length mixture is exactly a nonempty zero-sum sequence of these integer differences, and its length is the volume. Breadth-first search finds the shortest return to zero. Any zero-sum multiset can be ordered by choosing a nonpositive next difference when the partial sum is positive and conversely; therefore all partial sums stay within the largest absolute input difference. This proves the finite search bound without imposing an arbitrary volume cap.
